prompt_md: Two friends park at uniformly random, independent spots along a straight 1 km street. On average, how far apart are their cars, in meters?
prompt_short: Two cars park at random along a 1 km street. Average distance apart?
answer_display: about 333 m (a third of a km)
hint_md: Two random spots cut the street into three pieces.
explain_intuition_md: Two random spots cut the street into three pieces, each a third of a kilometer on average. The gap between the cars is the middle piece. 500 m is what you would get if one car always parked at an end.
